def render_full_screen(state: AppState, width: int, height: int) -> str:
    """Render the complete TUI to a string."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    lines = []

    # Header: 1 row
    if state.view_mode == ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH:
        tabs = [('[Flamegraph]', True), ('Top', False)]
    else:
        tabs = [('Flamegraph', False), ('[Top]', True)]

    title = render_title_bar(tabs, state.filename, width)
    lines.append(title)

    # Separator: 1 row
    lines.append(render_separator(width))

    # Calculate available rows for content
    # Bottom area: Selected/Match/Debug + separators + keybindings
    # Minimum bottom area:
    # - "Selected" line separator: 1
    # - Selected content: 1
    # - Bottom separator: 1
    # - Keybindings: 1
    # Optional: if in search mode, "Search" separator + input
    # Optional: if has match, "Match" separator + content
    # Optional: if debug, "Debug" separator + content

    bottom_rows = 4  # separator + content + separator + keybinds

    if state.search_pattern:
        bottom_rows += 2  # Match + value
    if state.debug:
        bottom_rows += 2  # Debug + value

    flamegraph_rows = height - 2 - bottom_rows  # minus title and top separator

    if flamegraph_rows <= 0:
        flamegraph_rows = 1

    if state.view_mode == ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH:
        # === Flamegraph view ===
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        total_rows = len(layout)

        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, flamegraph_rows)

        zoomed_ancestors = state.get_zoomed_ancestors()

        # Render visible rows
        start_row = state.scroll_offset
        end_row = min(start_row + flamegraph_rows, total_rows)

        rendered_count = 0
        for row_idx in range(start_row, end_row):
            row = layout[row_idx]
            line = render_flamegraph_row(
                row, width, state.cursor_frame,
                zoomed_ancestors, state.search_regex, state.search_matches
            )
            lines.append(line)
            rendered_count += 1

        # Fill remaining space with empty lines
        for _ in range(flamegraph_rows - rendered_count):
            lines.append('')

        # Bottom section
        # Search/Match section (if applicable)
        if state.search_pattern:
            total = state.tree.root.total
            match_total = state.total_match_samples
            pct = (match_total / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0.0
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Match {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'"{state.search_pattern}" [{match_total} samples, {pct:.2f}% of all]')

        # Selected section
        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Selected {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 9)}')

        # Selected frame info
        frame = state.cursor_frame
        total_all = state.tree.root.total
        frame_total = frame.total
        pct_all = (frame_total / total_all * 100) if total_all > 0 else float('nan')

        if state.zoom_frame is not None:
            zoom_total = state.zoom_frame.total
            pct_zoom = (frame_total / zoom_total * 100) if zoom_total > 0 else 0.0
            status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all, {pct_zoom:.2f}% of zoomed]'
        else:
            if total_all == 0:
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, NaN% of all]'
            else:
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all]'

        lines.append(status_text)

        # Debug section (if applicable)
        if state.debug:
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Debug {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'Debug: flamegraph:{state.debug_flamegraph_time:.2f}ms render:{state.debug_render_time:.2f}ms')

        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings
        if state.search_pattern:
            kb = ' [{bold}hjkl{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}enter/esc{reset}: zoom] [{bold}/{reset}: search] [{bold}#{reset}: search like cursor] [{bold}n/N{reset}: next/prev search] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'
        else:
            kb = ' [{bold}hjkl{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}enter/esc{reset}: zoom] [{bold}/{reset}: search] [{bold}#{reset}: search like cursor] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'

        # Format keybindings with bold
        kb_formatted = re.sub(r'\{bold\}(.+?)\{reset\}',
                              lambda m: f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{m.group(1)}{ansi_reset()}',
                              kb)
        lines.append(kb_formatted)

    else:
        # === Top view ===
        top_data = state.get_top_data()
        total_all = state.tree.root.total

        # Calculate column widths dynamically
        def fmt_count(count, total):
            pct = count / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0.0
            return f'{count} ({pct:.2f}%)'

        if top_data:
            max_total_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.total, total_all)) for f in top_data)
            max_own_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.own, total_all)) for f in top_data)
        else:
            max_total_w = len('Total')
            max_own_w = len('Own')

        max_total_w = max(max_total_w, len('Total'))
        max_own_w = max(max_own_w, len('Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.OWN else 'Own'))

        col1_w = max_total_w + 3
        col2_w = max_own_w + 3

        # Header row
        total_header = 'Total [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.TOTAL else 'Total'
        own_header = 'Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.OWN else 'Own'

        header = f'{total_header:<{col1_w}}{own_header:<{col2_w}}Name'
        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_reverse()}{header}{ansi_reset()}')

        # Data rows
        top_rows_available = flamegraph_rows - 1  # minus header

        # Clamp top scroll
        if state.top_cursor < state.top_scroll:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor
        elif state.top_cursor >= state.top_scroll + top_rows_available:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor - top_rows_available + 1
        state.top_scroll = max(0, min(state.top_scroll, max(0, len(top_data) - top_rows_available)))

        rendered_count = 0
        for i in range(state.top_scroll, min(state.top_scroll + top_rows_available, len(top_data))):
            frame = top_data[i]
            total_str = fmt_count(frame.total, total_all)
            own_str = fmt_count(frame.own, total_all)
            row_text = f'{total_str:<{col1_w}}{own_str:<{col2_w}}{frame.name}'

            if i == state.top_cursor:
                # Highlighted row
                lines.append(ansi_bg(65, 65, 65) + row_text + ansi_reset_bg())
            else:
                lines.append(row_text)
            rendered_count += 1

        # Fill remaining
        for _ in range(top_rows_available - rendered_count):
            lines.append('')

        # Bottom section (same as flamegraph view but no search display)
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # No Selected/Match section for Top view
        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings for Top view
        kb = ' [{bold}j/k{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}1{reset}: sort by total] [{bold}2{reset}: sort by own] [{bold}/{reset}: filter] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'
        kb_formatted = re.sub(r'\{bold\}(.+?)\{reset\}',
                              lambda m: f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{m.group(1)}{ansi_reset()}',
                              kb)
        lines.append(kb_formatted)

    # Input mode overlay (bottom of screen)
    if state.input_mode == InputMode.SEARCH:
        # Replace the last few lines with search input
        search_sep = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Search {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
        lines[-2] = search_sep
        lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    elif state.input_mode == InputMode.FILTER:
        # Filter input for Top view
        filter_sep = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Filter {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
        lines[-2] = filter_sep
        lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    state.debug_render_time = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000

    # Assemble the full screen
    output = ansi_goto(1, 1)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:height]):
        # Pad line to terminal width
        stripped = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[^m]*m', '', line)
        pad = max(0, width - len(stripped))
        output += line + ' ' * pad
        if i < height - 1:
            output += '\r\n'

    return output

def read_key(fd: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Read a single key from the terminal. Returns None if no input."""
    if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0)[0]:
        return None

    c = os.read(fd, 1)
    if not c:
        return None

    if c == b'\x1b':
        # Possible escape sequence
        if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
            return 'ESC'

        c2 = os.read(fd, 1)
        if c2 == b'[':
            # CSI sequence
            seq = b''
            while True:
                if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
                    break
                c3 = os.read(fd, 1)
                seq += c3
                if c3 and 0x40 <= c3[0] <= 0x7e:  # final byte
                    break

            if seq == b'A':
                return 'UP'
            elif seq == b'B':
                return 'DOWN'
            elif seq == b'C':
                return 'RIGHT'
            elif seq == b'D':
                return 'LEFT'
            else:
                return f'ESC[{seq.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'
        else:
            return f'ESC{c2.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'

    try:
        return c.decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None

def run_app(tree: FlamegraphTree, filename: str, sorted_mode: bool, debug: bool):
    """Run the interactive TUI application."""
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    old_settings = termios.tcgetattr(fd)

    try:
        # Enter raw mode
        tty.setraw(fd)

        # Enter alternate screen
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_alt_screen_enter())
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_hide_cursor())
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_clear_screen())
        sys.stdout.flush()

        state = AppState(tree, filename, sorted_mode, debug)

        def handle_resize(signum, frame):
            pass

        signal.signal(signal.SIGWINCH, handle_resize)

        width, height = get_terminal_size()
        prev_render = ''

        running = True
        while running:
            # Render
            new_width, new_height = get_terminal_size()
            if new_width != width or new_height != height:

            state.do_search(state.input_buffer)
        elif state.input_mode == InputMode.FILTER:
            pattern = state.input_buffer
            state.top_filter = pattern
            if pattern:
                try:
                    state.top_filter_regex = re.compile(pattern)
                except re.error:
                    state.top_filter_regex = None

        if state.input_buffer:

    """Handle keyboard input in flamegraph view. Returns False to quit."""
    layout = state.get_layout(width)

    bottom_rows = 4
    if state.search_pattern:
        bottom_rows += 2
    if state.debug:
        bottom_rows += 2
    visible_rows = max(1, height - 2 - bottom_rows)

        state.navigate_j(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.navigate_k(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('l', 'RIGHT'):
        state.navigate_l(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('h', 'LEFT'):
        state.navigate_h(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'f':  # Scroll down
        total_rows = len(layout)
        new_offset = state.scroll_offset + visible_rows
        max_offset = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)
        state.scroll_offset = min(new_offset, max_offset)

    elif key == 'b':  # Scroll up
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, state.scroll_offset - visible_rows)

    elif key == 'G':  # Scroll to bottom
        total_rows = len(layout)
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)

    elif key == 'g':  # Scroll to top
        state.scroll_offset = 0

    elif key == '\r' or key == '\n':  # Enter: zoom in
        state.zoom_in()
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'ESC':  # Esc: zoom out
        state.zoom_out()

        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

        state.input_buffer = ''

        state.navigate_next_match(layout, 1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'N':
        state.navigate_next_match(layout, -1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'r':
        state.reset()

    elif key == '\t':  # Tab: switch view
        state.view_mode = ViewMode.TOP

    if key in ('q', '\x03'):

    visible_rows = max(1, height - 2 - bottom_rows)
    top_rows_available = visible_rows - 1  # minus header

    top_data = state.get_top_data()
    n = len(top_data)

    if key in ('j', 'DOWN'):
        state.top_cursor = min(state.top_cursor + 1, max(0, n - 1))

    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.top_cursor = max(0, state.top_cursor - 1)

    elif key == 'f':
        state.top_scroll = min(state.top_scroll + top_rows_available,
                               max(0, n - top_rows_available))

    elif key == 'b':
        state.top_scroll = max(0, state.top_scroll - top_rows_available)

    elif key == '1':
        if state.top_sort == SortMode.TOTAL:
            pass  # Already sorted by total
        else:

        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '2':

        else:

        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '/':
        state.input_mode = InputMode.FILTER
        state.input_buffer = ''

    elif key == 'r':
        state.top_filter = None
        state.top_filter_regex = None
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '\t':
        state.view_mode = ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH

def main():

        prog='flamelens',
        description='Interactive flamegraph viewer for the terminal.'

def siphash13(data: bytes) -> int:
    """SipHash 1-3 with k0=k1=0 (matches Rust's DefaultHasher)"""
    mask64 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    v0 = 0 ^ 0x736f6d6570736575
    v1 = 0 ^ 0x646f72616e646f6d
    v2 = 0 ^ 0x6c7967656e657261
    v3 = 0 ^ 0x7465646279746573

    def rotl64(x, b):
        return ((x << b) | (x >> (64 - b))) & mask64

    def sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3):
        v0 = (v0 + v1) & mask64; v1 = rotl64(v1, 13); v1 ^= v0; v0 = rotl64(v0, 32)
        v2 = (v2 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 16); v3 ^= v2
        v0 = (v0 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 21); v3 ^= v0
        v2 = (v2 + v1) & mask64; v1 = rotl64(v1, 17); v1 ^= v2; v2 = rotl64(v2, 32)
        return v0, v1, v2, v3

    n = len(data)
    i = 0
    while i + 8 <= n:
        m = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+8], 'little')
        v3 ^= m
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
        v0 ^= m
        i += 8

    remaining = n - i
    last = (n & 0xff) << 56
    for j in range(remaining):
        last |= data[i+j] << (j * 8)

    v3 ^= last
    v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
    v0 ^= last

    v2 ^= 0xff
    for _ in range(3):
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)

    return (v0 ^ v1 ^ v2 ^ v3) & mask64

class Frame:

    def __init__(self, name: str, path: str):

        self.path = path
        self.total = 0  # total samples (including children)
        self.own = 0    # own samples (not in any child)
        self.children: List['Frame'] = []
        self.parent: Optional['Frame'] = None

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Frame({self.name!r}, total={self.total})"


class FlamegraphTree:
    """The parsed flamegraph data structure."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = Frame("all", "all")
        self.all_frames: Dict[str, Frame] = {"all": self.root}

    def add_stack(self, stack: str, count: int):
        """Add a folded stack entry to the tree."""
        parts = stack.split(';') if stack else []
        node = self.root
        path_parts = []

        for part in parts:
            path_parts.append(part)
            path = ';'.join(path_parts)
            if path not in self.all_frames:
                child = Frame(part, path)
                child.parent = node
                node.children.append(child)
                self.all_frames[path] = child
            node = self.all_frames[path]

        node.own += count

    def compute_totals(self):
        """Compute total samples for each node using post-order traversal."""
        def dfs(node: Frame) -> int:
            total = node.own
            for child in node.children:
                total += dfs(child)
            node.total = total
            return total
        dfs(self.root)

    def sort_children(self):
        """Sort children by total samples (descending)."""
        def dfs(node: Frame):
            node.children.sort(key=lambda c: c.total, reverse=True)
            for child in node.children:

        dfs(self.root)

    tree = FlamegraphTree()

        line = line.strip()
        if not line:

        # Format: "frame1;frame2;...;frameN count"
        parts = line.rsplit(' ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            stack, count_str = parts
            try:
                count = int(count_str)
            except ValueError:

            tree.add_stack(stack, count)

    if sorted_mode:

    else:
        return ansi_fg(fg_r, fg_g, fg_b) + ansi_bg(bg_r, bg_g, bg_b) + cell_text


def render_flamegraph_row(rects: List[FrameRect], width: int, cursor_frame: Optional[Frame],
                          zoomed_ancestors: set, search_regex: Optional[re.Pattern],
                          search_matches: set) -> str:
    """Render a single row of the flamegraph."""
    result = ''
    col = 0

    for rect in rects:
        if rect.width <= 0:
            continue

        is_cursor = (cursor_frame is not None and rect.frame is cursor_frame)
        is_zoom_anc = rect.frame in zoomed_ancestors
        is_match = rect.frame in search_matches

        match_info = None
        if is_match and search_regex and not is_cursor:
            # Find match positions in the name
            matches = list(search_regex.finditer(rect.frame.name))
            if matches:
                ranges = [(m.start(), m.end()) for m in matches]
                match_info = (rect.frame.name, ranges)

        result += render_frame(rect, is_cursor, is_zoom_anc, match_info, is_match)
        col += rect.width

    # Fill remaining width with default background
    if col < width:
        result += ansi_reset_fg() + ansi_reset_bg() + ' ' * (width - col)

    result += ansi_reset_fg() + ansi_reset_bg()
    return result


# ============================================================================
# App State
# ============================================================================

class ViewMode:
    FLAMEGRAPH = 'flamegraph'
    TOP = 'top'


class SortMode:
    OWN = 'own'
    TOTAL = 'total'


class InputMode:
    NORMAL = 'normal'
    SEARCH = 'search'
    FILTER = 'filter'


class AppState:
    def __init__(self, tree: FlamegraphTree, filename: str, sorted_mode: bool, debug: bool):
        self.tree = tree
        self.filename = filename
        self.sorted_mode = sorted_mode
        self.debug = debug

        # Current view
        self.view_mode = ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH

        # Flamegraph state
        self.cursor_frame: Frame = tree.root
        self.zoom_frame: Optional[Frame] = None
        self.scroll_offset: int = 0  # top row of visible area

        # Search state
        self.search_pattern: Optional[str] = None
        self.search_regex: Optional[re.Pattern] = None
        self.search_matches: set = set()  # set of Frame objects matching search

        # Input mode
        self.input_mode: str = InputMode.NORMAL
        self.input_buffer: str = ''

        # Top view state
        self.top_sort: str = SortMode.OWN
        self.top_filter: Optional[str] = None
        self.top_filter_regex: Optional[re.Pattern] = None
        self.top_cursor: int = 0  # row index in top view
        self.top_scroll: int = 0  # scroll offset for top view

        # Cached layout
        self._layout_cache: Optional[List[List[FrameRect]]] = None
        self._layout_width: int = 0

        # Debug timing
        self.debug_render_time: float = 0.0
        self.debug_flamegraph_time: float = 0.0

        # Precompute match samples
        self.total_match_samples: int = 0

    def get_layout(self, width: int) -> List[List[FrameRect]]:
        if self._layout_cache is None or self._layout_width != width:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            if self.zoom_frame is None:
                self._layout_cache = compute_layout(self.tree, width)
            else:
                self._layout_cache = compute_zoomed_layout(self.tree, width, self.zoom_frame)
            self._layout_width = width
            self.debug_flamegraph_time = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000

        return self._layout_cache

    def invalidate_layout(self):
        self._layout_cache = None

    def find_cursor_in_layout(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """Find (row, col_index) of cursor frame in layout."""
        for row_idx, row in enumerate(layout):
            for col_idx, rect in enumerate(row):
                if rect.frame is self.cursor_frame:
                    return row_idx, col_idx
        return 0, 0

    def ensure_cursor_visible(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]], visible_rows: int):
        """Adjust scroll offset so cursor is visible."""
        cursor_row, _ = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        total_rows = len(layout)

        if cursor_row < self.scroll_offset:
            self.scroll_offset = cursor_row
        elif cursor_row >= self.scroll_offset + visible_rows:
            self.scroll_offset = cursor_row - visible_rows + 1

        # Clamp scroll offset
        max_scroll = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)
        self.scroll_offset = min(self.scroll_offset, max_scroll)
        self.scroll_offset = max(0, self.scroll_offset)

    def get_zoomed_ancestors(self) -> set:
        """Get the set of frames that are ancestors of the zoom frame."""
        if self.zoom_frame is None:
            return set()
        ancestors = set()
        node = self.zoom_frame.parent
        while node is not None:
            ancestors.add(node)
            node = node.parent
        return ancestors

    def do_search(self, pattern: str):
        """Execute search with the given regex pattern."""
        self.search_pattern = pattern
        self.search_matches = set()
        self.total_match_samples = 0
        if pattern:
            try:
                self.search_regex = re.compile(pattern)
            except re.error:
                self.search_regex = None
                return

            # Find all matching frames
            for path, frame in self.tree.all_frames.items():
                if self.search_regex.search(frame.name):
                    self.search_matches.add(frame)
                    self.total_match_samples += frame.total
        else:
            self.search_regex = None

    def navigate_j(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor down (to first child)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        next_row = cursor_row + 1
        if next_row >= len(layout):
            return

        row = layout[next_row]
        if not row:
            return

        # Find the frame in the next row that overlaps with current cursor x position
        cursor_rect = layout[cursor_row][cursor_col]
        cursor_mid = cursor_rect.x + cursor_rect.width // 2

        # Find the frame in next row that contains this x position
        for rect in row:
            if rect.x <= cursor_mid < rect.x + rect.width:
                self.cursor_frame = rect.frame
                return

        # Fallback: first frame in next row
        self.cursor_frame = row[0].frame

    def navigate_k(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor up (to parent)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        if cursor_row == 0:
            return

        prev_row = cursor_row - 1
        row = layout[prev_row]
        if not row:
            return

        cursor_rect = layout[cursor_row][cursor_col]
        cursor_mid = cursor_rect.x + cursor_rect.width // 2

        for rect in row:
            if rect.x <= cursor_mid < rect.x + rect.width:
                self.cursor_frame = rect.frame
                return

        self.cursor_frame = row[0].frame

    def navigate_l(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor right (next sibling)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        row = layout[cursor_row]
        if cursor_col < len(row) - 1:
            self.cursor_frame = row[cursor_col + 1].frame

    def navigate_h(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor left (previous sibling)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        row = layout[cursor_row]
        if cursor_col > 0:
            self.cursor_frame = row[cursor_col - 1].frame

    def navigate_next_match(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]], direction: int = 1):
        """Navigate to next/previous search match."""
        if not self.search_matches:
            return

        # Collect all match frames in layout order (by row, then by x position)
        match_frames_ordered = []
        for row in layout:
            for rect in row:
                if rect.frame in self.search_matches:
                    match_frames_ordered.append(rect.frame)

        if not match_frames_ordered:
            return

        # Find current position
        try:
            idx = match_frames_ordered.index(self.cursor_frame)
        except ValueError:
            idx = -1

        new_idx = (idx + direction) % len(match_frames_ordered)
        self.cursor_frame = match_frames_ordered[new_idx]

    def zoom_in(self):
        """Zoom into the cursor frame."""
        if self.cursor_frame is not self.tree.root:
            self.zoom_frame = self.cursor_frame
            self.invalidate_layout()

    def zoom_out(self):
        """Reset zoom."""
        self.zoom_frame = None
        self.invalidate_layout()

    def reset(self):
        """Reset to default view."""
        self.cursor_frame = self.tree.root
        self.zoom_frame = None
        self.search_pattern = None
        self.search_regex = None
        self.search_matches = set()
        self.total_match_samples = 0
        self.scroll_offset = 0
        self.invalidate_layout()

    def get_top_data(self) -> List[Frame]:
        """Get data for the Top view (sorted and filtered)."""
        frames = []
        for path, frame in self.tree.all_frames.items():
            if frame is self.tree.root:
                continue
            if self.top_filter_regex is not None:
                if not self.top_filter_regex.search(frame.name):
                    continue
            frames.append(frame)

        if self.top_sort == SortMode.OWN:
            frames.sort(key=lambda f: (-f.own, -f.total, f.name))
        else:
            frames.sort(key=lambda f: (-f.total, -f.own, f.name))

        return frames


# ============================================================================
# Full Screen Renderer
# ============================================================================

def render_full_screen(state: AppState, width: int, height: int) -> str:
    """Render the complete TUI to a string."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    lines = []

    # Header: 1 row
    if state.view_mode == ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH:
        tabs = [('[Flamegraph]', True), ('Top', False)]
    else:
        tabs = [('Flamegraph', False), ('[Top]', True)]

    title = render_title_bar(tabs, state.filename, width)
    lines.append(title)

    # Separator: 1 row
    lines.append(render_separator(width))

    # Calculate available rows for content
    # Bottom area: Selected/Match/Debug + separators + keybindings
    # Minimum bottom area:
    # - "Selected" line separator: 1
    # - Selected content: 1
    # - Bottom separator: 1
    # - Keybindings: 1
    # Optional: if in search mode, "Search" separator + input
    # Optional: if has match, "Match" separator + content
    # Optional: if debug, "Debug" separator + content

    bottom_rows = 4  # separator + content + separator + keybinds

    if state.search_pattern:
        bottom_rows += 2  # Match + value
    if state.debug:
        bottom_rows += 2  # Debug + value

    flamegraph_rows = height - 2 - bottom_rows  # minus title and top separator

    if flamegraph_rows <= 0:
        flamegraph_rows = 1

    if state.view_mode == ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH:
        # === Flamegraph view ===
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        total_rows = len(layout)

        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, flamegraph_rows)

        zoomed_ancestors = state.get_zoomed_ancestors()

        # Render visible rows
        start_row = state.scroll_offset
        end_row = min(start_row + flamegraph_rows, total_rows)

        rendered_count = 0
        for row_idx in range(start_row, end_row):
            row = layout[row_idx]
            line = render_flamegraph_row(
                row, width, state.cursor_frame,
                zoomed_ancestors, state.search_regex, state.search_matches
            )
            lines.append(line)
            rendered_count += 1

        # Fill remaining space with empty lines
        for _ in range(flamegraph_rows - rendered_count):
            lines.append('')

        # Bottom section
        # Search/Match section (if applicable)
        if state.search_pattern:
            total = state.tree.root.total
            match_total = state.total_match_samples
            pct = (match_total / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0.0
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Match {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'"{state.search_pattern}" [{match_total} samples, {pct:.2f}% of all]')

        # Selected section
        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Selected {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 9)}')

        # Selected frame info
        frame = state.cursor_frame
        total_all = state.tree.root.total
        frame_total = frame.total
        pct_all = (frame_total / total_all * 100) if total_all > 0 else float('nan')

        if state.zoom_frame is not None:
            zoom_total = state.zoom_frame.total
            pct_zoom = (frame_total / zoom_total * 100) if zoom_total > 0 else 0.0
            status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all, {pct_zoom:.2f}% of zoomed]'
        else:
            if total_all == 0:
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, NaN% of all]'
            else:
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all]'

        lines.append(status_text)

        # Debug section (if applicable)
        if state.debug:
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Debug {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'Debug: flamegraph:{state.debug_flamegraph_time:.2f}ms render:{state.debug_render_time:.2f}ms')

        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings
        if state.search_pattern:
            kb = ' [{bold}hjkl{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}enter/esc{reset}: zoom] [{bold}/{reset}: search] [{bold}#{reset}: search like cursor] [{bold}n/N{reset}: next/prev search] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'
        else:
            kb = ' [{bold}hjkl{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}enter/esc{reset}: zoom] [{bold}/{reset}: search] [{bold}#{reset}: search like cursor] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'

        # Format keybindings with bold
        kb_formatted = re.sub(r'\{bold\}(.+?)\{reset\}',
                              lambda m: f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{m.group(1)}{ansi_reset()}',
                              kb)
        lines.append(kb_formatted)

    else:
        # === Top view ===
        top_data = state.get_top_data()
        total_all = state.tree.root.total

        # Calculate column widths dynamically
        def fmt_count(count, total):
            pct = count / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0.0
            return f'{count} ({pct:.2f}%)'

        if top_data:
            max_total_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.total, total_all)) for f in top_data)
            max_own_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.own, total_all)) for f in top_data)
        else:
            max_total_w = len('Total')
            max_own_w = len('Own')

        max_total_w = max(max_total_w, len('Total'))
        max_own_w = max(max_own_w, len('Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.OWN else 'Own'))

        col1_w = max_total_w + 3
        col2_w = max_own_w + 3

        # Header row
        total_header = 'Total [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.TOTAL else 'Total'
        own_header = 'Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == SortMode.OWN else 'Own'

        header = f'{total_header:<{col1_w}}{own_header:<{col2_w}}Name'
        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_reverse()}{header}{ansi_reset()}')

        # Data rows
        top_rows_available = flamegraph_rows - 1  # minus header

        # Clamp top scroll
        if state.top_cursor < state.top_scroll:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor
        elif state.top_cursor >= state.top_scroll + top_rows_available:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor - top_rows_available + 1
        state.top_scroll = max(0, min(state.top_scroll, max(0, len(top_data) - top_rows_available)))

        rendered_count = 0
        for i in range(state.top_scroll, min(state.top_scroll + top_rows_available, len(top_data))):
            frame = top_data[i]
            total_str = fmt_count(frame.total, total_all)
            own_str = fmt_count(frame.own, total_all)
            row_text = f'{total_str:<{col1_w}}{own_str:<{col2_w}}{frame.name}'

            if i == state.top_cursor:
                # Highlighted row
                lines.append(ansi_bg(65, 65, 65) + row_text + ansi_reset_bg())
            else:
                lines.append(row_text)
            rendered_count += 1

        # Fill remaining
        for _ in range(top_rows_available - rendered_count):
            lines.append('')

        # Bottom section (same as flamegraph view but no search display)
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # No Selected/Match section for Top view
        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings for Top view
        kb = ' [{bold}j/k{reset}: move cursor] [{bold}f/b{reset}: scroll] [{bold}1{reset}: sort by total] [{bold}2{reset}: sort by own] [{bold}/{reset}: filter] [{bold}r{reset}: reset] [{bold}tab{reset}: switch view] [{bold}q{reset}: quit]'
        kb_formatted = re.sub(r'\{bold\}(.+?)\{reset\}',
                              lambda m: f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{m.group(1)}{ansi_reset()}',
                              kb)
        lines.append(kb_formatted)

    # Input mode overlay (bottom of screen)
    if state.input_mode == InputMode.SEARCH:
        # Replace the last few lines with search input
        search_sep = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Search {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
        lines[-2] = search_sep
        lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    elif state.input_mode == InputMode.FILTER:
        # Filter input for Top view
        filter_sep = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Filter {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
        lines[-2] = filter_sep
        lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    state.debug_render_time = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000

    # Assemble the full screen
    output = ansi_goto(1, 1)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:height]):
        # Pad line to terminal width
        stripped = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[^m]*m', '', line)
        pad = max(0, width - len(stripped))
        output += line + ' ' * pad
        if i < height - 1:
            output += '\r\n'

    return output

# Input Handling
# ============================================================================

def read_key(fd: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Read a single key from the terminal. Returns None if no input."""
    if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0)[0]:
        return None

    c = os.read(fd, 1)
    if not c:
        return None

    if c == b'\x1b':
        # Possible escape sequence
        if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
            return 'ESC'

        c2 = os.read(fd, 1)
        if c2 == b'[':
            # CSI sequence
            seq = b''
            while True:
                if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
                    break
                c3 = os.read(fd, 1)
                seq += c3
                if c3 and 0x40 <= c3[0] <= 0x7e:  # final byte
                    break

            if seq == b'A':
                return 'UP'
            elif seq == b'B':
                return 'DOWN'
            elif seq == b'C':
                return 'RIGHT'
            elif seq == b'D':
                return 'LEFT'
            else:
                return f'ESC[{seq.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'
        else:
            return f'ESC{c2.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'

    try:
        return c.decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None


# ============================================================================
# Main Application
# ============================================================================

def run_app(tree: FlamegraphTree, filename: str, sorted_mode: bool, debug: bool):
    """Run the interactive TUI application."""
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    old_settings = termios.tcgetattr(fd)

    try:
        # Enter raw mode
        tty.setraw(fd)

        # Enter alternate screen
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_alt_screen_enter())
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_hide_cursor())
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_clear_screen())
        sys.stdout.flush()

        state = AppState(tree, filename, sorted_mode, debug)

        def handle_resize(signum, frame):
            pass

        signal.signal(signal.SIGWINCH, handle_resize)

        width, height = get_terminal_size()
        prev_render = ''

        running = True
        while running:
            # Render
            new_width, new_height = get_terminal_size()
            if new_width != width or new_height != height:
                width, new_height = new_width, new_height
                height = new_height
                state.invalidate_layout()
                prev_render = ''  # Force full redraw

            t_render = time.perf_counter()
            screen = render_full_screen(state, width, height)
            state.debug_render_time = (time.perf_counter() - t_render) * 1000

            sys.stdout.write(screen)
            sys.stdout.flush()

            # Input
            key = None
            while key is None:
                key = read_key(fd)
                if key is None:
                    time.sleep(0.016)  # ~60fps polling

            # Handle input based on mode
            if state.input_mode == InputMode.SEARCH or state.input_mode == InputMode.FILTER:
                handle_input_mode(state, key)
            else:
                if state.view_mode == ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH:
                    running = handle_flamegraph_keys(state, key, width, height)
                else:
                    running = handle_top_keys(state, key, width, height)

    finally:
        termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, old_settings)
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_show_cursor())
        sys.stdout.write(ansi_alt_screen_exit())
        sys.stdout.flush()


def handle_input_mode(state: AppState, key: str):
    """Handle keyboard input while in search/filter input mode."""
    if key == '\r' or key == '\n':  # Enter
        if state.input_mode == InputMode.SEARCH:
            state.do_search(state.input_buffer)
        elif state.input_mode == InputMode.FILTER:
            pattern = state.input_buffer
            state.top_filter = pattern
            if pattern:
                try:
                    state.top_filter_regex = re.compile(pattern)
                except re.error:
                    state.top_filter_regex = None
            else:
                state.top_filter_regex = None
            state.top_cursor = 0
            state.top_scroll = 0
        state.input_mode = InputMode.NORMAL
        state.input_buffer = ''

    elif key == 'ESC':
        state.input_mode = InputMode.NORMAL
        state.input_buffer = ''

    elif key == '\x7f' or key == '\x08':  # Backspace
        if state.input_buffer:
            state.input_buffer = state.input_buffer[:-1]

    elif len(key) == 1 and key.isprintable():
        state.input_buffer += key


def handle_flamegraph_keys(state: AppState, key: str, width: int, height: int) -> bool:
    """Handle keyboard input in flamegraph view. Returns False to quit."""
    layout = state.get_layout(width)

    # Calculate visible rows
    bottom_rows = 4
    if state.search_pattern:
        bottom_rows += 2
    if state.debug:
        bottom_rows += 2
    visible_rows = max(1, height - 2 - bottom_rows)

    if key in ('q', '\x03'):  # q or Ctrl+C
        return False

    elif key in ('j', 'DOWN'):
        state.navigate_j(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.navigate_k(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('l', 'RIGHT'):
        state.navigate_l(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key in ('h', 'LEFT'):
        state.navigate_h(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'f':  # Scroll down
        total_rows = len(layout)
        new_offset = state.scroll_offset + visible_rows
        max_offset = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)
        state.scroll_offset = min(new_offset, max_offset)

    elif key == 'b':  # Scroll up
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, state.scroll_offset - visible_rows)

    elif key == 'G':  # Scroll to bottom
        total_rows = len(layout)
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)

    elif key == 'g':  # Scroll to top
        state.scroll_offset = 0

    elif key == '\r' or key == '\n':  # Enter: zoom in
        state.zoom_in()
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'ESC':  # Esc: zoom out
        state.zoom_out()
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == '/':
        state.input_mode = InputMode.SEARCH
        state.input_buffer = ''

    elif key == '#':
        # Search for frames matching the cursor's name
        if state.cursor_frame:
            state.do_search(re.escape(state.cursor_frame.name))

    elif key == 'n':
        state.navigate_next_match(layout, 1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'N':
        state.navigate_next_match(layout, -1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)

    elif key == 'r':
        state.reset()

    elif key == '\t':  # Tab: switch view
        state.view_mode = ViewMode.TOP

    return True


def handle_top_keys(state: AppState, key: str, width: int, height: int) -> bool:
    """Handle keyboard input in top view. Returns False to quit."""
    if key in ('q', '\x03'):
        return False

    bottom_rows = 4
    visible_rows = max(1, height - 2 - bottom_rows)
    top_rows_available = visible_rows - 1  # minus header

    top_data = state.get_top_data()
    n = len(top_data)

    if key in ('j', 'DOWN'):
        state.top_cursor = min(state.top_cursor + 1, max(0, n - 1))

    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.top_cursor = max(0, state.top_cursor - 1)

    elif key == 'f':
        state.top_scroll = min(state.top_scroll + top_rows_available,
                               max(0, n - top_rows_available))

    elif key == 'b':
        state.top_scroll = max(0, state.top_scroll - top_rows_available)

    elif key == '1':
        if state.top_sort == SortMode.TOTAL:
            pass  # Already sorted by total
        else:
            state.top_sort = SortMode.TOTAL
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '2':
        if state.top_sort == SortMode.OWN:
            pass  # Already sorted by own
        else:
            state.top_sort = SortMode.OWN
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '/':
        state.input_mode = InputMode.FILTER
        state.input_buffer = ''

    elif key == 'r':
        state.top_filter = None
        state.top_filter_regex = None
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0

    elif key == '\t':
        state.view_mode = ViewMode.FLAMEGRAPH

    return True


# ============================================================================
# Entry Point
# ============================================================================

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='flamelens',
        description='Interactive flamegraph viewer for the terminal.'
    )
    parser.add_argument('filename', metavar='FILENAME', nargs='?',
                        help='Profile data filename')
    parser.add_argument('--sorted', action='store_true',
                        help='Whether to sort the stacks by time spent')
    parser.add_argument('--echo', action='store_true',
                        help='Print data to stdout on exit. Useful when piping to other tools')
    parser.add_argument('--debug', action='store_true',
                        help='Show debug info')
    parser.add_argument('--pid', type=int,
                        help='PID of process to attach to (live mode)')
    parser.add_argument('-V', '--version', action='version', version='flamelens 0.3.1')

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Read input
    if args.filename:
        try:
            with open(args.filename, 'r') as f:
                data = f.read()
            filename = args.filename
        except IOError as e:
            print(f'Error: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
    elif not sys.stdin.isatty():
        # Read from stdin
        try:
            data = sys.stdin.read()
        except IOError as e:
            print(f'Error: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        filename = None

        # After reading stdin, we need stdin to be a terminal for interactive mode
        # Reopen /dev/tty
        try:
            sys.stdin = open('/dev/tty', 'r')
        except IOError:
            print('Error: could not open terminal', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        filename = ''
    else:
        print('Error: no input provided. Use a filename or pipe data.', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    if args.echo:
        sys.stdout.write(data)
        if not data.endswith('\n'):
            sys.stdout.write('\n')
        sys.stdout.flush()

    # Parse data
    tree = parse_folded_stacks(data, sorted_mode=args.sorted)

    if filename is None:
        filename = ''

    # Run the app
    try:
        run_app(tree, filename, args.sorted, args.debug)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""

def siphash13(data: bytes) -> int:
    """SipHash 1-3 with k0=k1=0 (matches Rust's DefaultHasher)"""
    mask64 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    v1 = 0x646f72616e646f6d
    v2 = 0x6c7967656e657261
    v3 = 0x7465646279746573

        return ((x << b) | (x >> (64 - b))) & mask64

    def sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3):

        v2 = (v2 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 16); v3 ^= v2
        v0 = (v0 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 21); v3 ^= v0
        v2 = (v2 + v1) & mask64; v1 = rotl64(v1, 17); v1 ^= v2; v2 = rotl64(v2, 32)
        return v0, v1, v2, v3

    n = len(data)
    i = 0
    while i + 8 <= n:
        m = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+8], 'little')
        v3 ^= m
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
        v0 ^= m
        i += 8

    remaining = n - i
    last = (n & 0xff) << 56
    for j in range(remaining):
        last |= data[i+j] << (j * 8)

    v3 ^= last
    v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
    v0 ^= last

    for _ in range(3):
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)

    return (v0 ^ v1 ^ v2 ^ v3) & mask64


def frame_color(path: str) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
    """Compute frame background color from full stack path."""
    h = siphash13(path.encode('utf-8') + b'\xff')

    r = 205 + int(v * 50)
    g = int(v * 230)
    b = int(v * 55)
    return r, g, b

class Frame:
    """A single frame in the flamegraph tree."""
    __slots__ = ['name', 'path', 'total', 'own', 'children', 'parent']

    def __init__(self, name: str, path: str):
        self.name = name
        self.path = path
        self.total: int = 0
        self.own: int = 0
        self.children: List['Frame'] = []
        self.parent: Optional['Frame'] = None

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Frame({self.name!r}, total={self.total})"


class FlamegraphTree:
    """The parsed flamegraph data structure."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = Frame("all", "all")
        self.all_frames: Dict[str, Frame] = {"all": self.root}

    def add_stack(self, stack: str, count: int):
        """Add a folded stack entry to the tree."""
        parts = stack.split(';') if stack else []
        node = self.root
        path_parts: List[str] = []

        for part in parts:
            path_parts.append(part)
            path = ';'.join(path_parts)
            if path not in self.all_frames:
                child = Frame(part, path)
                child.parent = node
                node.children.append(child)
                self.all_frames[path] = child
            node = self.all_frames[path]

        node.own += count

    def compute_totals(self):
        """Compute total samples for each node using post-order traversal."""
        def dfs(node: Frame) -> int:
            total = node.own
            for child in node.children:
                total += dfs(child)
            node.total = total
            return total
        dfs(self.root)

    def sort_children(self):
        """Sort children by total samples (descending)."""
        def dfs(node: Frame):
            node.children.sort(key=lambda c: c.total, reverse=True)
            for child in node.children:
                dfs(child)
        dfs(self.root)

    tree = FlamegraphTree()

        line = line.strip()
        if not line:

        parts = line.rsplit(' ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            stack, count_str = parts
            try:

                    parent_x: int, parent_width: int, depth: int,
                    rows: List[List[FrameRect]]):
    """Layout children of a frame into rows."""
    if not frames:
        return

    while len(rows) <= depth:
        rows.append([])

    # Calculate total samples in children
    children_total = sum(f.total for f in frames)

    # Total width allocated to children (proportional to their sample count)
    if parent_total > 0:
        children_alloc = int(children_total * parent_width // parent_total)
    else:
        children_alloc = 0

    if children_alloc <= 0:
        return

    x = parent_x
    placed = 0

    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        if i == len(frames) - 1:
            # Last child gets the remainder
            w = children_alloc - placed
        else:
            if parent_total > 0:
                w = int(frame.total * parent_width // parent_total)
            else:
                w = 0

        if w <= 0:
            x += w

            continue

        rect = FrameRect(frame, x, w, depth)
        rows[depth].append(rect)

    else:
        flamegraph_part = f'{ansi_bold()}Flamegraph{ansi_reset()}'
        top_part = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}[Top]{ansi_reset()}'

    tabs_str = f' {flamegraph_part} | {top_part}'

    right_str = f'{ansi_bold()}flamelens v0.3.1{ansi_reset()}'
    center_str = f'{ansi_bold()}{filename}{ansi_reset()}'

    tabs_len = len(strip_ansi(tabs_str))
    right_len = len(strip_ansi(right_str))
    center_len = len(strip_ansi(center_str))

    available = width - tabs_len - right_len
    center_pad = available - center_len
    left_pad = center_pad // 2

    result = tabs_str + ' ' * max(0, left_pad)
    result += center_str
    result_len = len(strip_ansi(result))
    pad_to_right = width - right_len - result_len
    if pad_to_right > 0:
        result += ' ' * pad_to_right
    result += right_str

    return result


def render_separator(width: int) -> str:
    return HLINE * width


def render_frame_cell(frame: Frame, width: int, is_cursor: bool,
                      is_zoomed_ancestor: bool, is_search_match: bool,
                      search_regex: Optional[re.Pattern],
                      prev_fg: Optional[Tuple[int,int,int]]) -> Tuple[str, Optional[Tuple[int,int,int]]]:
    """
    Render a single frame cell and return (text, final_fg_color).
    prev_fg is the fg color used by the previous cell (for optimization).
    """
    if width <= 0:
        return '', prev_fg

    name = frame.name
    path = frame.path

    # Determine background and foreground colors
    if is_cursor:
        bg = (250, 250, 250)
        fg = (10, 10, 10)
        fg_is_light = False
    elif is_zoomed_ancestor:
        base = frame_color(path)
        bg = (int(base[0] * 0.4), int(base[1] * 0.4), int(base[2] * 0.4))
        fg = (225, 225, 225)
        fg_is_light = True
    elif is_search_match:
        bg = (10, 35, 150)
        fg = (225, 225, 225)
        fg_is_light = True
    else:
        bg = frame_color(path)
        fg_is_light_val = frame_fg_is_light(bg[0])
        fg = (225, 225, 225) if fg_is_light_val else (10, 10, 10)
        fg_is_light = fg_is_light_val

    # Build text content
    # Format: " " + name, padded to width
    display_name = name[:width-1] if width > 1 else ''
    cell_content = ' ' + display_name
    padding = width - len(cell_content)
    if padding > 0:
        cell_content += ' ' * padding
    cell_content = cell_content[:width]

    # Build escape sequences
    result = ansi_bg(bg[0], bg[1], bg[2])

    # Only emit fg change if it differs from previous
    if fg != prev_fg:
        result += ansi_fg(fg[0], fg[1], fg[2])

    if is_search_match and search_regex and not is_cursor:
        # Highlight matches within the name
        matches = list(search_regex.finditer(display_name))
        if matches:
            result += ' '  # leading space
            pos = 0
            for m in matches:
                if m.start() > pos:
                    result += display_name[pos:m.start()]
                result += ansi_bold() + ansi_fg(225, 10, 10)
                result += display_name[m.start():m.end()]
                result += ansi_reset() + ansi_bg(bg[0], bg[1], bg[2]) + ansi_fg(fg[0], fg[1], fg[2])
                pos = m.end()
            if pos < len(display_name):
                result += display_name[pos:]
            # Padding
            used = 1 + len(display_name)
            result += ' ' * max(0, width - used)
        else:
            result += cell_content
    else:
        result += cell_content

    return result, fg


def render_flamegraph_row(rects: List[FrameRect], width: int,
                          cursor_frame: Optional[Frame],
                          zoomed_ancestors: Set[Frame],
                          search_regex: Optional[re.Pattern],
                          search_matches: Set[Frame]) -> str:
    """Render a single row of the flamegraph."""
    result = ''
    col = 0
    prev_fg = None  # track current fg for optimization

    for rect in rects:
        if rect.width <= 0:
            continue

        is_cursor = (cursor_frame is not None and rect.frame is cursor_frame)
        is_zoom_anc = rect.frame in zoomed_ancestors
        is_match = (rect.frame in search_matches) and not is_cursor

        cell, prev_fg = render_frame_cell(
            rect.frame, rect.width, is_cursor, is_zoom_anc, is_match,
            search_regex, prev_fg
        )
        result += cell
        col += rect.width

    # Reset at end of row
    result += ansi_reset_fg() + ansi_reset_bg()

    return result

class AppState:
    def __init__(self, tree: FlamegraphTree, filename: str, sorted_mode: bool, debug: bool):
        self.tree = tree
        self.filename = filename
        self.sorted_mode = sorted_mode
        self.debug = debug

        # Current view
        self.view_mode = 'flamegraph'

        # Flamegraph state
        self.cursor_frame: Frame = tree.root
        self.zoom_frame: Optional[Frame] = None
        self.scroll_offset: int = 0

        # Search state
        self.search_pattern: Optional[str] = None
        self.search_regex: Optional[re.Pattern] = None
        self.search_matches: Set[Frame] = set()
        self.total_match_samples: int = 0

        # Input mode
        self.input_mode: str = 'normal'
        self.input_buffer: str = ''

        # Top view state
        self.top_sort: str = 'own'  # 'own' or 'total'
        self.top_filter_regex: Optional[re.Pattern] = None
        self.top_cursor: int = 0
        self.top_scroll: int = 0

        # Cached layout
        self._layout_cache: Optional[List[List[FrameRect]]] = None
        self._layout_width: int = 0

        # Debug timing
        self.debug_render_time: float = 0.0
        self.debug_flamegraph_time: float = 0.0

    def get_layout(self, width: int) -> List[List[FrameRect]]:
        if self._layout_cache is None or self._layout_width != width:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            if self.zoom_frame is None:
                self._layout_cache = compute_layout(self.tree, width)
            else:
                self._layout_cache = compute_zoomed_layout(self.tree, width, self.zoom_frame)
            self._layout_width = width
            self.debug_flamegraph_time = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        return self._layout_cache

    def invalidate_layout(self):
        self._layout_cache = None

    def find_cursor_in_layout(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """Find (row_idx, col_idx) of cursor frame."""
        for row_idx, row in enumerate(layout):
            for col_idx, rect in enumerate(row):
                if rect.frame is self.cursor_frame:
                    return row_idx, col_idx
        return 0, 0

    def ensure_cursor_visible(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]], visible_rows: int):
        """Adjust scroll so cursor is visible."""
        cursor_row, _ = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        total_rows = len(layout)

        if cursor_row < self.scroll_offset:
            self.scroll_offset = cursor_row
        elif cursor_row >= self.scroll_offset + visible_rows:
            self.scroll_offset = cursor_row - visible_rows + 1

        max_scroll = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)
        self.scroll_offset = max(0, min(self.scroll_offset, max_scroll))

    def get_zoomed_ancestors(self) -> Set[Frame]:
        if self.zoom_frame is None:
            return set()
        ancestors = set()
        node = self.zoom_frame.parent
        while node is not None:
            ancestors.add(node)
            node = node.parent
        return ancestors

    def do_search(self, pattern: str):
        self.search_pattern = pattern
        self.search_matches = set()
        self.total_match_samples = 0
        if pattern:
            try:
                self.search_regex = re.compile(pattern)
            except re.error:
                self.search_regex = None
                return
            for frame in self.tree.all_frames.values():
                if self.search_regex.search(frame.name):
                    self.search_matches.add(frame)
                    self.total_match_samples += frame.total
        else:
            self.search_regex = None

    def navigate_j(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor down."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        next_row_idx = cursor_row + 1
        if next_row_idx >= len(layout):
            return

        row = layout[next_row_idx]
        if not row:
            return

        cursor_rect = layout[cursor_row][cursor_col]
        cursor_mid = cursor_rect.x + cursor_rect.width // 2

        for rect in row:
            if rect.x <= cursor_mid < rect.x + rect.width:
                self.cursor_frame = rect.frame
                return
        if row:
            self.cursor_frame = row[0].frame

    def navigate_k(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor up."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        if cursor_row == 0:
            return

        row = layout[cursor_row - 1]
        if not row:
            return

        cursor_rect = layout[cursor_row][cursor_col]
        cursor_mid = cursor_rect.x + cursor_rect.width // 2

        for rect in row:
            if rect.x <= cursor_mid < rect.x + rect.width:
                self.cursor_frame = rect.frame
                return
        if row:
            self.cursor_frame = row[-1].frame

    def navigate_l(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor right (next sibling)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        row = layout[cursor_row]
        if cursor_col < len(row) - 1:
            self.cursor_frame = row[cursor_col + 1].frame

    def navigate_h(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]]):
        """Move cursor left (prev sibling)."""
        cursor_row, cursor_col = self.find_cursor_in_layout(layout)
        row = layout[cursor_row]
        if cursor_col > 0:
            self.cursor_frame = row[cursor_col - 1].frame

    def navigate_next_match(self, layout: List[List[FrameRect]], direction: int = 1):
        """Navigate to next/prev search match in layout order."""
        if not self.search_matches:
            return
        match_frames = []
        for row in layout:
            for rect in row:
                if rect.frame in self.search_matches:
                    match_frames.append(rect.frame)
        if not match_frames:
            return
        try:
            idx = match_frames.index(self.cursor_frame)
        except ValueError:
            idx = -1
        new_idx = (idx + direction) % len(match_frames)
        self.cursor_frame = match_frames[new_idx]

    def zoom_in(self):
        if self.cursor_frame is not self.tree.root:
            self.zoom_frame = self.cursor_frame
            self.invalidate_layout()

    def zoom_out(self):
        self.zoom_frame = None
        self.invalidate_layout()

    def reset(self):
        self.cursor_frame = self.tree.root
        self.zoom_frame = None
        self.search_pattern = None
        self.search_regex = None
        self.search_matches = set()
        self.total_match_samples = 0
        self.scroll_offset = 0
        self.invalidate_layout()

    def get_top_data(self) -> List[Frame]:
        """Get sorted/filtered data for Top view."""
        frames = [f for path, f in self.tree.all_frames.items() if f is not self.tree.root]
        if self.top_filter_regex:
            frames = [f for f in frames if self.top_filter_regex.search(f.name)]
        if self.top_sort == 'own':
            frames.sort(key=lambda f: (-f.own, -f.total, f.name))
        else:
            frames.sort(key=lambda f: (-f.total, -f.own, f.name))
        return frames

def compute_visible_rows(height: int, has_match: bool, has_debug: bool) -> int:
    """Compute how many flamegraph rows are visible."""
    # Layout:
    # Row 1: Title bar
    # Row 2: Top separator (───)
    # Rows 3..(3+N-1): flamegraph/top content  [N rows]
    # If has_match: separator + content [2 rows]
    # Selected separator [1 row]
    # Selected content [1 row]
    # If has_debug: Debug separator + content [2 rows]
    # Bottom separator [1 row]
    # Keybindings [1 row]
    # Total non-content = 2 (title+sep) + (2 if match) + 1+1 (selected) + (2 if debug) + 1+1 (sep+kb) = 6 + extras
    bottom = 4  # selected_sep + selected_content + bottom_sep + keybindings
    if has_match:
        bottom += 2
    if has_debug:
        bottom += 2
    return max(1, height - 2 - bottom)


def render_full_screen(state: AppState, width: int, height: int) -> str:
    t0_render = time.perf_counter()

    lines: List[str] = []

    # Title bar
    lines.append(render_title_bar(state.view_mode, state.filename, width))
    # Top separator
    lines.append(render_separator(width))

    has_match = bool(state.search_pattern) and state.view_mode == 'flamegraph'
    has_debug = state.debug and state.view_mode == 'flamegraph'

    flamegraph_rows = compute_visible_rows(height, has_match, has_debug)

    if state.view_mode == 'flamegraph':
        # === Flamegraph view ===
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        total_rows = len(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, flamegraph_rows)

        zoomed_ancestors = state.get_zoomed_ancestors()

        start_row = state.scroll_offset
        end_row = min(start_row + flamegraph_rows, total_rows)

        rendered = 0
        for row_idx in range(start_row, end_row):
            row = layout[row_idx]
            line = render_flamegraph_row(
                row, width, state.cursor_frame,
                zoomed_ancestors, state.search_regex, state.search_matches
            )
            lines.append(line)
            rendered += 1

        for _ in range(flamegraph_rows - rendered):
            lines.append('')

        # Match section
        if has_match:
            total_all = state.tree.root.total
            pct = (state.total_match_samples / total_all * 100) if total_all > 0 else 0.0
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Match {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'"{state.search_pattern}" [{state.total_match_samples} samples, {pct:.2f}% of all]')

        # Selected section
        frame = state.cursor_frame
        total_all = state.tree.root.total
        frame_total = frame.total
        pct_all = (frame_total / total_all * 100) if total_all > 0 else float('nan')

        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Selected {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 9)}')

        if state.zoom_frame is not None:
            zoom_total = state.zoom_frame.total
            pct_zoom = (frame_total / zoom_total * 100) if zoom_total > 0 else 0.0
            status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all, {pct_zoom:.2f}% of zoomed]'
        else:
            import math
            if math.isnan(pct_all):
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, NaN% of all]'
            else:
                status_text = f'{frame.name} [{frame_total} samples, {pct_all:.2f}% of all]'

        lines.append(status_text)

        # Debug section
        if has_debug:
            lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Debug {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 6)}')
            lines.append(f'Debug: flamegraph:{state.debug_flamegraph_time:.2f}ms render:{state.debug_render_time:.2f}ms')

        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings
        if has_match:
            kb_items = [
                ('hjkl', 'move cursor'), ('f/b', 'scroll'), ('enter/esc', 'zoom'),
                ('/', 'search'), ('#', 'search like cursor'), ('n/N', 'next/prev search'),
                ('r', 'reset'), ('tab', 'switch view'), ('q', 'quit')
            ]
        else:
            kb_items = [
                ('hjkl', 'move cursor'), ('f/b', 'scroll'), ('enter/esc', 'zoom'),
                ('/', 'search'), ('#', 'search like cursor'),
                ('r', 'reset'), ('tab', 'switch view'), ('q', 'quit')
            ]

        kb = ' ' + ' '.join(f'[{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{k}{ansi_reset()}: {v}]'
                            for k, v in kb_items)
        lines.append(kb)

        # Input overlay
        if state.input_mode == 'search':
            sep_text = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Search {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
            lines[-2] = sep_text
            lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    else:
        # === Top view ===
        top_data = state.get_top_data()
        total_all = state.tree.root.total

        def fmt_count(count: int, total: int) -> str:
            pct = count / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0.0
            return f'{count} ({pct:.2f}%)'

        # Calculate column widths
        if top_data:
            max_total_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.total, total_all)) for f in top_data)
            max_own_w = max(len(fmt_count(f.own, total_all)) for f in top_data)
        else:
            max_total_w = 5  # 'Total'
            max_own_w = 7    # 'Own [▼]'

        max_total_w = max(max_total_w, len('Total [▼]' if state.top_sort == 'total' else 'Total'))
        max_own_w = max(max_own_w, len('Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == 'own' else 'Own'))

        col1_w = max_total_w + 3
        col2_w = max_own_w + 3

        total_header = 'Total [▼]' if state.top_sort == 'total' else 'Total'
        own_header = 'Own [▼]' if state.top_sort == 'own' else 'Own'

        header = f'{total_header:<{col1_w}}{own_header:<{col2_w}}Name'
        lines.append(f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_reverse()}{header}{ansi_reset()}')

        top_content_rows = flamegraph_rows - 1  # minus header row

        # Ensure cursor is visible
        if state.top_cursor < state.top_scroll:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor
        elif state.top_cursor >= state.top_scroll + top_content_rows:
            state.top_scroll = state.top_cursor - top_content_rows + 1
        state.top_scroll = max(0, min(state.top_scroll,
                                       max(0, len(top_data) - top_content_rows)))

        rendered = 0
        for i in range(state.top_scroll,
                       min(state.top_scroll + top_content_rows, len(top_data))):
            frame = top_data[i]
            total_str = fmt_count(frame.total, total_all)
            own_str = fmt_count(frame.own, total_all)
            row_text = f'{total_str:<{col1_w}}{own_str:<{col2_w}}{frame.name}'

            if i == state.top_cursor:
                lines.append(ansi_bg(65, 65, 65) + row_text + ansi_reset_bg())
            else:
                lines.append(row_text)
            rendered += 1

        for _ in range(top_content_rows - rendered):
            lines.append('')

        # Bottom separator
        lines.append(render_separator(width))

        # Keybindings for Top view
        kb_items = [
            ('j/k', 'move cursor'), ('f/b', 'scroll'),
            ('1', 'sort by total'), ('2', 'sort by own'),
            ('/', 'filter'), ('r', 'reset'), ('tab', 'switch view'), ('q', 'quit')
        ]
        kb = ' ' + ' '.join(f'[{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}{k}{ansi_reset()}: {v}]'
                             for k, v in kb_items)
        lines.append(kb)

        # Filter overlay
        if state.input_mode == 'filter':
            sep_text = f'{ansi_bold()}{ansi_fg(3,0,0)}Filter {ansi_reset()}{HLINE * (width - 7)}'
            lines[-2] = sep_text
            lines[-1] = state.input_buffer

    state.debug_render_time = (time.perf_counter() - t0_render) * 1000

    # Assemble screen output
    output = ansi_goto(1, 1)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:height]):
        stripped_len = len(strip_ansi(line))
        pad = max(0, width - stripped_len)
        output += line + ' ' * pad
        if i < height - 1:
            output += '\r\n'

    return output

def read_key(fd: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Read a single key. Returns None if no input available."""
    if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0)[0]:
        return None

    c = os.read(fd, 1)
    if not c:
        return None

    if c == b'\x1b':
        if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
            return 'ESC'
        c2 = os.read(fd, 1)
        if c2 == b'[':
            seq = b''
            while True:
                if not select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)[0]:
                    break
                c3 = os.read(fd, 1)
                seq += c3
                if c3 and 0x40 <= c3[0] <= 0x7e:
                    break
            if seq == b'A': return 'UP'
            elif seq == b'B': return 'DOWN'
            elif seq == b'C': return 'RIGHT'
            elif seq == b'D': return 'LEFT'
            else: return f'ESC[{seq.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'
        else:
            return f'ESC{c2.decode("latin1", errors="replace")}'

    try:
        return c.decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None

def handle_input_mode(state: AppState, key: str):
    """Handle keyboard input in search/filter mode."""
    if key in ('\r', '\n'):
        if state.input_mode == 'search':
            state.do_search(state.input_buffer)
        elif state.input_mode == 'filter':
            pattern = state.input_buffer
            if pattern:
                try:
                    state.top_filter_regex = re.compile(pattern)
                except re.error:
                    state.top_filter_regex = None
            else:
                state.top_filter_regex = None
            state.top_cursor = 0
            state.top_scroll = 0
        state.input_mode = 'normal'
        state.input_buffer = ''
    elif key == 'ESC':
        state.input_mode = 'normal'
        state.input_buffer = ''
    elif key in ('\x7f', '\x08'):
        state.input_buffer = state.input_buffer[:-1]
    elif len(key) == 1 and key.isprintable():
        state.input_buffer += key


def handle_flamegraph_keys(state: AppState, key: str, width: int, height: int) -> bool:
    """Returns False to quit."""
    layout = state.get_layout(width)
    has_match = bool(state.search_pattern)
    has_debug = state.debug
    visible_rows = compute_visible_rows(height, has_match, has_debug)

    if key in ('q', '\x03'):
        return False
    elif key in ('j', 'DOWN'):
        state.navigate_j(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.navigate_k(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key in ('l', 'RIGHT'):
        state.navigate_l(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key in ('h', 'LEFT'):
        state.navigate_h(layout)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key == 'f':
        total_rows = len(layout)
        new_offset = state.scroll_offset + visible_rows
        state.scroll_offset = min(new_offset, max(0, total_rows - visible_rows))
    elif key == 'b':
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, state.scroll_offset - visible_rows)
    elif key == 'G':
        total_rows = len(layout)
        state.scroll_offset = max(0, total_rows - visible_rows)
    elif key == 'g':
        state.scroll_offset = 0
    elif key in ('\r', '\n'):
        state.zoom_in()
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key == 'ESC':
        state.zoom_out()
        layout = state.get_layout(width)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key == '/':
        state.input_mode = 'search'
        state.input_buffer = ''
    elif key == '#':
        if state.cursor_frame:
            state.do_search(re.escape(state.cursor_frame.name))
    elif key == 'n':
        state.navigate_next_match(layout, 1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key == 'N':
        state.navigate_next_match(layout, -1)
        state.ensure_cursor_visible(layout, visible_rows)
    elif key == 'r':
        state.reset()
    elif key == '\t':
        state.view_mode = 'top'

    return True


def handle_top_keys(state: AppState, key: str, width: int, height: int) -> bool:
    """Returns False to quit."""
    has_match = False
    has_debug = False
    visible_rows = compute_visible_rows(height, has_match, has_debug)
    top_content_rows = max(1, visible_rows - 1)  # minus header
    top_data = state.get_top_data()

        return False
    elif key in ('j', 'DOWN'):
        state.top_cursor = min(state.top_cursor + 1, max(0, n - 1))
    elif key in ('k', 'UP'):
        state.top_cursor = max(0, state.top_cursor - 1)
    elif key == 'f':
        state.top_scroll = min(state.top_scroll + top_content_rows,
                               max(0, n - top_content_rows))
    elif key == 'b':
        state.top_scroll = max(0, state.top_scroll - top_content_rows)
    elif key == '1':
        state.top_sort = 'total'
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0
    elif key == '2':
        state.top_sort = 'own'
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0
    elif key == '/':
        state.input_mode = 'filter'
        state.input_buffer = ''
    elif key == 'r':
        state.top_filter_regex = None
        state.top_cursor = 0
        state.top_scroll = 0
    elif key == '\t':
        state.view_mode = 'flamegraph'

    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    old_settings = termios.tcgetattr(fd)

    try:
        tty.setraw(fd)

        sys.stdout.write(ansi_hide_cursor())

# SipHash 1-3 (Rust's DefaultHasher)

def siphash13(data: bytes) -> int:
    """SipHash 1-3 with k0=k1=0 (matches Rust's DefaultHasher)"""
    mask64 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    v0 = 0x736f6d6570736575
    v1 = 0x646f72616e646f6d
    v2 = 0x6c7967656e657261
    v3 = 0x7465646279746573

    def rotl64(x, b):
        return ((x << b) | (x >> (64 - b))) & mask64

    def sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3):
        v0 = (v0 + v1) & mask64; v1 = rotl64(v1, 13); v1 ^= v0; v0 = rotl64(v0, 32)
        v2 = (v2 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 16); v3 ^= v2
        v0 = (v0 + v3) & mask64; v3 = rotl64(v3, 21); v3 ^= v0
        v2 = (v2 + v1) & mask64; v1 = rotl64(v1, 17); v1 ^= v2; v2 = rotl64(v2, 32)
        return v0, v1, v2, v3

    n = len(data)
    i = 0
    while i + 8 <= n:
        m = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+8], 'little')
        v3 ^= m
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
        v0 ^= m
        i += 8

    remaining = n - i
    last = (n & 0xff) << 56
    for j in range(remaining):
        last |= data[i+j] << (j * 8)

    v3 ^= last
    v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)
    v0 ^= last

    v2 ^= 0xff
    for _ in range(3):
        v0, v1, v2, v3 = sip_round(v0, v1, v2, v3)

    return (v0 ^ v1 ^ v2 ^ v3) & mask64


def frame_color(path: str) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
    """Compute frame background color from full stack path."""
    h = siphash13(path.encode('utf-8') + b'\xff')
    v = h / (2**64)
    r = 205 + int(v * 50)
    g = int(v * 230)
    b = int(v * 55)
    return r, g, b
